Package edu.cnu.mdi.mapping.loader

Class GeoJsonCityLoader.CityFeature

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.mapping.loader.GeoJsonCityLoader.CityFeature
Enclosing class:
GeoJsonCityLoader
public static final class GeoJsonCityLoader.CityFeature extends Object
Immutable representation of a single populated-place (city) feature.

Coordinate fields use radians throughout, matching the convention used by all IMapProjection implementations. Use Math.toDegrees(double) when displaying values to users.

  • Constructor Details

    • CityFeature

      public CityFeature(String name, String countryName, double longitude, double latitude, long population, int scalerank)
      Constructs a new city feature.
      Parameters:
      name - display name of the city (may be null if absent from the source data)
      countryName - name of the country (may be null)
      longitude - longitude in radians (east positive); should be in (-π, π]
      latitude - latitude in radians (north positive); should be in [-π/2, π/2]
      population - population estimate, or -1 if unknown
      scalerank - importance rank where 0 denotes the largest / most prominent cities and larger values denote progressively less prominent ones; -1 if unknown

    • getScalerank

      public int getScalerank()
      Returns the city's scalerank: a small integer where 0 indicates the most prominent cities (capitals, megacities) and larger values indicate progressively less prominent ones. Returns -1 if the value was not present in the source data.

      Scalerank is used by CityPointRenderer to filter which cities and labels are rendered at a given zoom level.

      Returns:
      scalerank or -1
